decoding: EnemyDatabase.asset (TXEKernel.Enemy.EnemyDataBaseRecords) holds one palette Record per enemy body or part. _targetKey is KANAI.Unsafe.ProtectValue.Mask(string): every char XOR 0x3C ('}NQc~P]_W' -> 'Arm_Black'). _hitpoint is a float whose IEEE-754 bits are XOR 0x00CF7A89 (Record.get_hitpoint RVA 0x2721920 -> ProtectValue.Conversion(float,int) 0x1E2AB10: movd eax,xmm0; xor eax,edx); _score is an int XOR 0x00136ACF (get_score 0x2721980 -> Conversion(int,int) 0x1E2AA10). Both keys are immediates in the getters, not the jseed/sseed/pseed literals (those mask the asset-level _mScore/_mJewel/_mPi). _pipil, _jewel, _priority, _galleryNo, _modelSize (EnemySize Small..BOSS), the tole* fields (toleType normal/veryhigh/high/low/verylow), _partsName and _aliasCnt are stored in clear. A model finds its rows with GetDatas(prefabName): key = GetDBKey(name) (split on '_', join pieces 2.. with '_': Pf_Ene_Sa01 -> Sa01, Pf_EneObj_Meteo_La01 -> Meteo_La01) masked and compared with _targetKey; the row with an empty _partsName is the body, and each prefab PartsList entry takes the row with its _partsName. isBreakthrough means the laser passes through (blocksLaser = !isBreakthrough); isLockOn = lock-on target; isGround/isRangeFire/isDamageScore/isRateTarget are copied as is.
